about.heroBody: WellnessHub is Muscat's destination for expert beauty, fitness, and self-care — all in one place.
about.missionHeadline: More than a salon. A sanctuary.
about.missionP1: Founded in Muscat, WellnessHub brings together the finest beauty specialists, fitness instructors, and skin therapists under one roof. We believe self-care is not a luxury — it's a right.
about.missionP2: Whether you're here for a quick blow-dry or a full advanced skin treatment, every visit is designed to leave you refreshed, confident, and cared for.
about.val1Body: Every treatment is delivered with genuine attention and warmth. You are not just a booking — you are a guest.
about.val2Body: Our specialists hold international certifications and train continuously. Excellence is our baseline.
about.val3Body: We use proven techniques and premium products so every visit leaves you looking and feeling noticeably better.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1b: By accessing or using Ultimate Wellness HUB ("WellnessHub", "we", "us", or "our"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations of the Sultanate of Oman. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform or services.
terms.s2b: Ultimate Wellness HUB is a wellness and beauty services provider registered in the Sultanate of Oman (Commercial Registration No. 000000000), located at Maroon Street, Alkhoud, Muscat, Oman.
terms.s3b: WellnessHub provides an online platform for browsing, booking, and purchasing wellness and beauty services, including one-off appointments, memberships, subscriptions, and digital products. All services are delivered by our own qualified, employed staff. Availability may vary by date, time, and location.
terms.s4p1: Use of this platform is permitted for individuals aged 15 and above. Users between the ages of 15 and 17 must have explicit consent from a parent or legal guardian to register, book services, or make purchases.
terms.s4p2: By completing a booking or registration on behalf of a minor, the guardian confirms their consent and accepts responsibility under these terms.
terms.s5p1: You may register using an email and password or via Google Sign-In. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. WellnessHub is not liable for any loss resulting from unauthorized use of your account.
terms.s5p2: Account deletion is available upon request. Please contact us directly at the details in Section 16. If the deletion option is not visible in your account settings, reach out and we will process it manually.
terms.s6p1: Bookings are confirmed upon receipt of full payment. Prices are displayed in Omani Rial (OMR) and are subject to change without prior notice. We accept payments via Paymob and Apple Pay.
terms.s6p2: For memberships and subscriptions, recurring charges apply on the agreed billing cycle. It is your responsibility to keep payment details up to date.
terms.s7p1: Refund requests may be submitted in person at our desk or by contacting us at least 48 hours before your scheduled appointment. Refunds are not available for bookings that have already been confirmed and are within the scheduled appointment window.
terms.s7p2: In eligible cases, refunds may be issued in full or partially depending on the circumstances. Our team will assess each request individually. Approved refunds are processed within 2–4 business days to the original payment method.
terms.s7p3: If you do not attend your appointment without prior notice, please contact our desk. No-show cases are reviewed on a case-by-case basis.
terms.s8p1: Our services involve topical, cosmetic, and wellness treatments. You are responsible for reviewing all product ingredients and treatment details before booking or purchasing. WellnessHub is not liable for adverse reactions arising from undisclosed allergies or pre-existing conditions.
terms.s8p2: You must inform our staff of any relevant health conditions, skin sensitivities, allergies, medications, or medical history prior to receiving any service. Failure to disclose may affect the outcome of your treatment and limits our liability.
terms.s8p3: Nothing on this platform constitutes medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns.
terms.s9b: You agree not to misuse the platform, attempt unauthorized access, submit false information, impersonate another person, or engage in any conduct that may harm WellnessHub, its staff, or other users. Violation may result in immediate account suspension.
terms.s10b: All content on this platform — including text, graphics, logos, and service descriptions — is the property of Ultimate Wellness HUB and may not be reproduced, distributed, or used without our prior written consent.
terms.s11p1: We collect only the data necessary to provide our services and improve your experience. We do not sell, trade, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. We use anonymous analytics to understand platform usage. No user tracking across external sites is performed.
terms.s11p2: For full details on data handling, please review our Privacy Policy.
terms.s12b: WellnessHub is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our platform or services. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for the specific service in question.
terms.s13b: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman. Any disputes arising from the use of our platform or services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Muscat, Oman.
terms.s14b: These Terms are provided in both English and Arabic. In the event of any conflict between the two versions, the English version shall prevail unless otherwise required by applicable Omani law.
terms.s15b: We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. We will indicate the revised date at the top of this page. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the updated Terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1b: Ultimate Wellness HUB ("WellnessHub", "we", "us", or "our") is a wellness and beauty services provider registered in the Sultanate of Oman, located at Maroon Street, Alkhoud, Muscat. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our platform.
privacy.s2intro: We collect the following categories of information:
privacy.s2li1: Account data: your name, email address, phone number, and date of birth when you register or book a service.
privacy.s2li2: Booking data: service selections, appointment history, and transaction records.
privacy.s2li3: Payment data: payment is processed by Paymob and Apple Pay. We do not store full card numbers or payment credentials on our servers.
privacy.s2li4: Usage data: anonymous analytics — page views, session duration, and general interaction patterns. No cross-site tracking or advertising profiling is performed.
privacy.s2li5: Device & technical data: browser type, operating system, and IP address for security and platform stability purposes.
privacy.s2p2: We do not collect sensitive health data through our platform. If you voluntarily disclose health conditions to our staff before a treatment, that information is handled confidentially and used solely to deliver safe, appropriate services.
privacy.s3li1: Process and confirm bookings, memberships, and purchases
privacy.s3li2: Send booking confirmations, reminders, and service updates
privacy.s3li4: Improve platform performance through anonymous analytics
privacy.s3li5: Maintain platform security and prevent fraud
privacy.s3li6: Comply with applicable Omani laws and regulations
privacy.s3p2: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for commercial or marketing purposes.
privacy.s4p1: Your data is stored securely using Supabase infrastructure. We apply industry-standard encryption at rest and in transit (TLS). Access to personal data is restricted to authorised staff only.
privacy.s4p2: While we take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data, no system is fully immune to risk. We will notify affected users promptly in the event of a confirmed data breach.
privacy.s5p1: We use browser local storage to remember your session preferences such as cart items and saved favourites. We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party behavioural profiling tools.
privacy.s5p2: Anonymous, aggregated analytics may be collected to understand how users interact with the platform. This data cannot be used to identify you individually.
privacy.s6intro: We work with the following third-party services, each subject to their own privacy policies:
privacy.s6li1: Google OAuth — optional sign-in via your Google account
privacy.s6li4: Supabase — database and file storage infrastructure
privacy.s6li5: Cloudflare Turnstile — spam and bot protection during registration
privacy.s6p2: No third-party advertising networks, social media pixels, or cross-site tracking scripts are used.
privacy.s7b: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as required to provide services. Booking and transaction records may be kept for a period required by Omani commercial law. Upon account deletion, personal data is removed from active systems within a reasonable period, except where retention is legally required.
privacy.s8li1: Access the personal data we hold about you
privacy.s8li3: Request deletion of your account and associated data
privacy.s8li4: Withdraw consent for any non-essential data processing
privacy.s8li5: Lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority in Oman
privacy.s8p2: To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details in Section 10. Account deletion can be requested through your account settings. If the option is not visible, contact us directly.
privacy.s9b: Our platform is accessible to users aged 15 and above with parental or guardian consent. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 15 without verified guardian consent. If you believe a minor has registered without appropriate consent, contact us immediately.
privacy.s10intro: For any privacy-related questions, data access requests, or deletion requests, contact us:
privacy.s10address: Maroon Street, Alkhoud, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
privacy.s11b: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be reflected by the revised date at the top of this page. Continued use of the platform after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
